headline: Google previews Tool Retrieval for Gemini agents with large tool libraries
body: Google has put Tool Retrieval in preview in the Gemini Interactions API. Agents load tool parameter schemas only when a task needs them, which Google says reduces latency and input token costs. Tool Retrieval has no separate charge and works with Gemini 3.6 and later models.
note: For finance teams wiring agents into many internal systems, the cost of sending every tool definition on each call is the part this addresses.

evidence.text: Tool Retrieval is now in preview in the Gemini Interactions API.
By loading parameter schemas only when needed, you reduce latency and input token costs for complex tasks.
We are launching Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API to help your agents manage large tool libraries more efficiently.
When an agent connects to dozens or even hundreds of tools, sending every full parameter schema on every request adds up fast.
Tool Retrieval has no separate charge.
Tool Retrieval works with Gemini 3.6 and later models, including all Gemini 4 models , in the Interactions API.
